ref_atoms.ref_content: fatal_fault alert: This fatal alert is triggered when a fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault is detected.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific alert name (fatal_fault) with clear trigger condition (fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault).

ref_atoms.ref_content: recov_ctrl_update_err alert: This recoverable alert is triggered upon detecting an update error in the shadowed Control Register.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific alert name (recov_ctrl_update_err) with clear trigger condition (update error in shadowed Control Register).

ref_atoms.ref_content: BUS.INTEGRITY: End-to-end bus integrity scheme.
DEBUG_POLICY_VALID.CONFIG.SHADOW: Debug policy valid register is shadowed.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Identifies specific register (Debug policy valid register) and its shadowed protection mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: DEBUG_POLICY_CATEGORY.CONFIG.SHADOW: Debug policy category register is shadowed.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Identifies specific register (Debug policy category register) and its shadowed protection mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: HALT.FSM.SPARSE: The halt FSM uses a sparse state encoding.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Identifies specific FSM (halt FSM) and its encoding scheme (sparse state encoding).

ref_atoms.ref_content: lc_hw_debug_en: Multibit life cycle hardware debug enable signal coming from life cycle controller, asserted when the hardware debug mechanisms are enabled in the system.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific input signal (lc_hw_debug_en) with assertion condition (hardware debug mechanisms enabled).

ref_atoms.ref_content: lc_dft_en: Test enable qualifier coming from life cycle controller. This signal enables TEST & RMA mode accesses.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific input signal (lc_dft_en) with defined function (enables TEST & RMA mode accesses).

ref_atoms.ref_content: lc_raw_test_rma: Test enable qualifier coming from life cycle controller. This signal enables RAW, TEST and RMA mode accesses.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific input signal (lc_raw_test_rma) with defined function (enables RAW, TEST, RMA mode accesses).

ref_atoms.ref_content: halt_cpu_boot: External request to halt the CPU until a JTAG command allows the boot process to continue.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific input signal (halt_cpu_boot) with defined function (halt CPU boot until JTAG command).

ref_atoms.ref_content: continue_cpu_boot: Artificial ROM control input to the pwrmgr to halt the boot process.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific output signal (continue_cpu_boot) with defined function (halt boot process).

ref_atoms.ref_content: DEBUG_POLICY_VALID_SHADOWED register: shadowed register. Debug Policy Valid. Once valid is set to Mubi4::True, the debug policy cannot be written anymore. Writing to this register is gated by the debug_policy_category_shadowed register. Update error triggers recov_ctrl_update_err alert, storage error triggers fatal_fault alert. Field: debug_policy_valid [3:0] (mubi) indicates validity of the debug policy output.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific shadowed register with write gating (by debug_policy_category_shadowed), alert associations, and a behavioral field (debug_policy_valid).

ref_atoms.ref_content: DEBUG_POLICY_CATEGORY_SHADOWED register: shadowed register. Debug Policy category. hwqe/hwre/hwext enabled. Update error triggers recov_ctrl_update_err alert, storage error triggers fatal_fault alert. Field: debug_policy_category [6:0] (resval 0x50) indicates the current debug authorization policy distributed to the SoC to govern debug/DFT feature unlock.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific shadowed register with hardware access qualifiers, alert associations, and a field that defines the debug authorization policy.

ref_atoms.ref_content: TRACE_DEBUG_POLICY_CATEGORY register: Trace register to observe the debug category that is determined either by hardware or by software. Field: category [6:0] (resval 0x50) - the debug policy determined by hardware or software.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific trace register that reflects the debug category (hardware or software determined), with a defined field (category).

ref_atoms.ref_content: TRACE_DEBUG_POLICY_VALID_RELOCKED register: Trace register to observe the valid or relocked state that is determined either by hardware or by software. Fields: relocked [7:4] (mubi) - the relocked state determined by hardware or software; valid [3:0] (mubi) - the valid state determined by hardware or software.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific trace register that reflects valid/relocked states (hardware or software determined), with defined fields (relocked, valid).

ref_atoms.ref_content: STATUS register (core): Debug Status Register. Fields: auth_debug_intent_set [0] - status bit indicating whether the debug intent hardware strap was set (if set, SoC treated as under debug); auth_window_open [4] - tells whether debug authorization exchange can take place (set when auth_debug_intent_set=1 and SoC reset sequence paused); auth_window_closed [5] - indicates SoC reset sequence unpaused, debug authorization exchange cannot take place until next reset (reset sequence triggered by OT RoT); auth_unlock_success [6] - unlock protocol succeeded at requested level; auth_unlock_failed [7] - unlock protocol failed at requested level.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific status register with clearly defined behavioral meaning for each bit (auth_debug_intent_set, auth_window_open, etc.) and conditions.

ref_atoms.ref_content: JTAG_TRACE_DEBUG_POLICY_CATEGORY register: Trace register to observe the debug category that is determined either by hardware or by software. Field: category [6:0] (resval 0x50) - the debug policy determined by hardware or software.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific JTAG-accessible trace register that reflects the debug category (hardware or software determined).

ref_atoms.ref_content: JTAG_TRACE_DEBUG_POLICY_VALID_RELOCKED register: Trace register to observe the valid or relocked state that is determined either by hardware or by software. Fields: relocked [7:4] (mubi) - the relocked state determined by hardware or software; valid [3:0] (mubi) - the valid state determined by hardware or software.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific JTAG-accessible trace register that reflects valid/relocked states (hardware or software determined).

ref_atoms.ref_content: JTAG_CONTROL register: JTAG control register to interact with the boot flow. Field: boot_continue [0] - JTAG bit to stop or continue the boot flow of Ibex (1'b0: Stop and halt boot flow; 1'b1: Continue with the boot flow and let Ibex fetch code).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific JTAG control register with a field (boot_continue) that controls CPU boot flow continuation.

ref_atoms.ref_content: JTAG_STATUS register: Debug Status Register. Fields: auth_debug_intent_set [0] - status bit indicating whether the debug intent hardware strap was set (if set, SoC treated as under debug); auth_window_open [4] - tells whether debug authorization exchange can take place (set when auth_debug_intent_set=1 and SoC reset sequence paused); auth_window_closed [5] - indicates SoC reset sequence unpaused, debug authorization exchange cannot take place until next reset (reset sequence triggered by OT RoT); auth_unlock_success [6] - unlock protocol succeeded at requested level; auth_unlock_failed [7] - unlock protocol failed at requested level.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific JTAG-accessible status register with clearly defined behavioral meaning for each bit and conditions.

ref_atoms.ref_content: JTAG_BOOT_STATUS register: Debug boot status register that tells important boot state information. This information is reflected only if the hw_dft_en signal is true. Fields: main_clk_status [0] - status of main clock activation; io_clk_status [1] - status of IO clock activation; otp_done [2] - OTP controller initialization complete; lc_done [3] - lifecycle controller initialization done, LC policy decoded and set; cpu_fetch_en [4] - indication from power manager to IBEX to start code execution; halt_fsm_state [10:5] - state of the halt FSM; boot_greenlight_done [13:11] - green lights for boot process (_done_ from base ROM [0], second ROM [1], this module [2]), all need to be set for boot to proceed; boot_greenlight_good [16:14] - green lights status (_good_ from base ROM [0], second ROM [1], this module [2]).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific JTAG boot status register with multiple fields that reflect hardware boot states, gated by hw_dft_en signal.

ref_atoms.ref_content: JTAG_TRACE_SOC_DBG_STATE register: Reports the current debug state coming from OTP. This information is reflected only if the hw_dft_en signal is true. Field: soc_dbg_state [31:0] - the current debug state.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific JTAG trace register that reflects OTP debug state, gated by hw_dft_en signal.
